notes: KTDC: tariff pages 2026-27 fetched with curl from ktdc.com. Room-rate tables are NOT in the HTML for Tea County (Munnar), Samudra (Kovalam), Aranya Nivas (Thekkady), Water Scapes (Kumarakom), Golden Peak (Ponmudi), Malabar Courtyard (Kannur), Mascot (Trivandrum: meals/banquet only); rates are therefore unverified for those, not guessed. Tamarind Kondotty (Deluxe A/C 2200 CP), Mannarkkad (Deluxe 2200 CP), Changanacherry (Deluxe 1750 EP) print one flat rate all year. KTDC season definition: where split, season = Oct to 19 Dec + 6 Jan to March; peak = 20 Dec to 5 Jan (Samudra lawn note says peak 15 Dec to 31 Jan, Diwali/Pooja); monsoon = June-Sept (Thekkady) or April-Sept (Kumarakom Gateway). Thekkady treats April-May as season. KTDC cancellation page flags Onam 22-29 Aug 2026, Pooja 17-24 Oct 2026, Diwali 8-14 Nov 2026 as holiday periods (no rate given). || KSTDC Mayura hotels and JLR publish NO season/off-season rates: only weekday/weekend base plus 'Seasonal hike applicable' with no dates or percent. JLR season text (descriptive): Hampi peak Nov-Feb; Kabini dry-season wildlife Mar-May, monsoon Jul-Sep fewer sightings; Dubare post-monsoon mid-Sept to early March ideal, monsoon Jul to mid-Sept; Bandipur Mar-May best for wildlife. JLR packages say 'tariffs are dynamic'. Karnataka therefore gives no usable ratio. || TTDC: no published season/off-season tariff card obtainable (official site down from here). Booking-engine live quotes only; they show flat base rates with occasional holiday/weekend spikes, and no sample could reach the Apr-Jun hill season (live window ends about 1 Jan 2027). travelmeout.com carries an old (c.2021) TTDC season/off-season table but it is a blog/aggregator and was NOT used. || APTDC (Andhra): official tourism.ap.gov.in fails TLS verification from here and was not bypassed; the authorised-partner aptourismhotels.in/moreinfo prints only a per-hotel tariff RANGE (e.g. Araku Mayuri Rs 2100-6160 across room types) and 'extra tariff on weekends for some hotels', with no season dates. Telangana (TGTDC): tourism.telangana.gov.in/all-hotels prints a single 'Price' per hotel (e.g. Ananthagiri Rs 2016) and no season; a 2024 newsreport (newsmeter.in) says Mon-Thu tariffs were halved on a pilot, i.e. weekday/weekend not season. Puducherry (PTDC): pondytourism.py.gov.in online booking site loads but tariffs sit behind hotel-selection forms; tourism.py.gov.in does not respond. No rows for these three. || Private hotels: only properties whose own page printed season dates with rates are included. Checked and rejected (single flat rate, no season split): Lantern Stay Wayanad (not valid 18 Dec-2 Jan), Pranavam Wayanad, Hotel Soorya Castle Wayanad, Kodai Resort Hotel, Elegant Holiday Homes Madikeri. Kudle Ocean Front Gokarna prints overlapping date bands with a blank AC cell so was not used. Over the Hill (overthehill.in) and Woodrose Wayanad blocked the fetch (HTTP 406/403) and were not bypassed. Coorg, Mysore, Hampi, Puducherry, Gokarna: no private property with a clean printed season/off-season table found.
